summary: Jet.AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of its special meeting of stockholders held on July 2, 2026, to vote on a proposed merger with flyExclusive via a spin-off and merger structure. The meeting was adjourned due to insufficient votes; no vote was taken. The filing is a routine procedural update regarding stockholder voting, not a definitive event trigger. No deal terms or final outcome are provided. The filing does not announce an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation, but merely updates meeting status. This is a routine current report.
